prompt.generated_prompt_string: A portrait of a clearly adult woman in a professional recording studio, wearing headphones and looking upwards and slightly to the right away from the camera. She has long wavy vibrant red hair, fair skin with visible freckles, blue eyes, a contemplative expression, and minimal natural makeup. She wears a white ribbed fitted tank top and pink baggy sweatpants, black over-ear studio headphones with a cable, multiple bracelets on the left wrist, rings, and a neat manicure. She is seated or leaning back with hands resting naturally on the hips or upper thighs, body angled slightly right. Include a large silver condenser microphone with black pop filter and shock mount partially out of focus on the right, dark acoustic soundproofing panels, wood paneling, and an electrical outlet near the floor. Use soft direct studio lighting at approximately 4500K, an eye-level or slightly high angle, medium framing from the thighs up, a 50mm lens at approximately f/2, natural freckles and skin texture, fine grain, and authentic recording-session atmosphere.
